description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing hash table behaviors, including hash policies, custom hash and equality functors, allocator wrappers, and helper functions for extracting items and keys from containers. It is part of the Abseil C++ library's internal testing utilities.

classes.name: WithId
classes.description: A template class that assigns a unique ID to each instance, used for testing hash and equality behaviors.

classes.name: NonStandardLayout
classes.description: A struct with a string value, supporting equality and hash operations, used for testing hash policies.

classes.name: StatefulTestingHash
classes.description: A hash functor that inherits from WithId, used for testing hash functions with state.

classes.name: StatefulTestingEqual
classes.description: An equality functor that inherits from WithId, used for testing equality functions with state.

classes.name: Alloc
classes.description: A custom allocator wrapper that tracks an ID, used for testing allocator-aware containers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Hash operator for generic types, utilizing absl::Hash.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Equality operator for generic types, compares two objects for equality.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the WithId instance.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from a map container into a vector.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Extracts keys from a set container into a vector.
